acceptance.requirement: Server-side cross-tenant read/write isolation for every M1 endpoint.
Agent, Manager and Admin permission matrix passes positive and negative tests.
Open production registration cannot create an active production agent or membership.
Task event projections are idempotent under retry and concurrency.
Past scheduled meeting has an outcome or exactly one visible escalation.
Assignment, status, outcome and reschedule audit completeness equals 100 percent.
Agent operational queue reports zero false overdue tasks after completed events.
Manager control tower supports capacity, assignment and reasoned reassignment.
Tenant-scoped operational search and saved views work without cross-tenant leakage.
Migration rehearsal, repeated deploy no-op, schema parity and legacy counts pass.
Touched flows expose loading, empty, error, retry, conflict, offline and permission states.
Keyboard, mobile and 200 percent zoom critical paths have zero critical or serious accessibility findings.
Synthetic cremation and relative-burial Agent and Manager Preview scenarios pass on exact SHA.
Independent adversarial review reports zero P0 and P1 findings.
